description: Implement image vulnerability scanning, container hardening, and security issue remediation for containers orchestrated with Kubernetes or Docker Swarm.
Integrate a selected scanning tool to automatically scan container images for known vulnerabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a container image is built, When the scanning tool runs as part of the CI pipeline, Then identified vulnerabilities are reported in a traceable format.

summary: Integrate scanning tool into CI pipeline
description: Add the chosen scanning tool (e.g., Trivy, Clair, or Anchore) to the CI workflow to automatically scan each built image.
Define which vulnerability severities trigger build failures or alerts.
Apply hardening measures to containers to meet the CIS Docker Benchmark standards.
acceptance_criteria: Given a container runtime environment, When hardening configurations are applied, Then the environment complies with the CIS Docker Benchmark.

description: Create scripts or configuration templates that enforce the required benchmark settings.
Run compliance checks on test clusters to ensure all hardening rules are satisfied.
Automate remediation of identified security issues within the CI/CD pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Given vulnerabilities are reported, When the remediation workflow is triggered, Then the affected image is rebuilt without the identified issues and redeployed.

description: Design a pipeline step that initiates image rebuilds when vulnerabilities exceed the defined threshold.

summary: Automate rebuild and redeployment of fixed images
description: Ensure the pipeline automatically rebuilds, tests, and redeploys images after successful remediation.
